items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: He played with Schilling band for a long time.

ctx.x: I'm trying to think of the guys from the French Quarter then. Who was that? Johnny Lala was around? Was he with you to? Well, Johnny Lala didn't play with the Italian band, no.
He played with just like Valley Hoon, dances and all that stuff. Yeah. He played with Schilling band for a long time.
